overview: Holotype ROM 63823 and paratypes preserve mandibles, maxillipeds and subdivided basipods used to test a stem-mandibulate body plan.

ecology.diet: Feeding inferred from mandibles; prey not preserved
ecology.locomotion: Benthic or swimming mode inferred from appendages

evidenceSummary: Named material directly preserves the appendages; stem-mandibulate placement is a matrix result and does not make Tokummia an ancestor of living groups.

overview: More than 1,800 specimens document a bivalved mandibulate body plan with mandibles and serial appendages; pancrustacean placement remains analytical.

ecology.diet: Small-particle or prey feeding inferred from mandibles

evidenceSummary: The large museum series supports repeatable anatomy; pancrustacean placement and swimming-predator ecology remain topology and functional interpretations.

commonNameZh: 滇虫甲壳幼体发育系列
overview: Phosphatized individuals from several growth stages preserve exites and eucrustacean-like limb organization without fixing a crown-origin date.

ecology.habitat: Marine setting represented by Orsten-type preservation
ecology.locomotion: Limb-based swimming or crawling inferred; performance unknown

evidenceSummary: Developmental stages directly document appendage construction; crown-eucrustacean placement and epipodite homology remain character interpretations.
